objective: Search and apply a filter on the page named DB1 in Notion.
notes: Ensure you are logged into Notion before starting.

steps.title: Open Notion
steps.action: Navigate to Notion's website and log in.
steps.expected_result: User is logged into their Notion account.

steps.title: Locate DB1 Page
steps.action: Search for the page named DB1 in the Notion sidebar.

steps.title: Open DB1 Page
steps.action: Click on the DB1 page to open it.
steps.expected_result: DB1 page is opened and visible.

steps.title: Apply Filter
steps.action: Select the filter option and apply the desired filter criteria.
steps.expected_result: Filter is applied to the DB1 page.

success_criteria: DB1 page is successfully located and opened.
Filter is applied correctly on the DB1 page.
